# 2_extracted_text

Text pulled out of the documents in `1_source_documents/`: every line, with its page and position, so every rule can point back to its exact spot. Format: see `packages/document_extraction/README.md`.

**Generated by code only. Never hand-edit.** To change it, fix the extraction code and re-run `python -m document_extraction`. CI fails if these files don't match a fresh extraction.
